capabilities: Search memory records by title, body, tags, and project as you type
Filter the list via clickable coloured tag chips with record counts and a project dropdown
Surface pinned records in a dedicated section at the top
Preview records with two-line excerpts and open the underlying note in one click
extras: Read-only: records can only be added, deleted, or pinned via the MCP server's tools or by editing frontmatter, and the vault mirror can drift since sync is one-way. Docs include an upgrade note: the plugin id changed from obsidian-memorry to memorry, so the old folder must be renamed or removed to avoid a duplicate listing.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian companion plugin for memorry — a local, API-key-free MCP memory server.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated way to browse and filter the memory notes the memorry server syncs, beyond general file lists and search.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian companion plugin for memorry — a local, API-key-free MCP memory server.

summary: Sidebar pane for searching, filtering, and browsing the memory records the memorry MCP server mirrors into the vault as Markdown notes.
